summary: Well-structured test suite comprehensively covering core functionality: parse_version, validate_version, determine_bump, bump_version, update_version_file, generate_changelog, and main (unit tests via semver-bump.bats); workflow structure and references (workflow.bats); and integration via act (run-act-tests.sh). Clear test organization with proper setup/teardown, good fixture isolation, and descriptive test names. Gaps: (1) Coverage misses some conventional commit variants (fix! syntax and scope in commits like 'feat(api):' not explicitly tested, though code supports them); BREAKING CHANGE footer in changelog output not verified; (2) Rigor lacks edge cases—empty/malformed input files, invalid JSON, unusual version formats (leading zeros, very large numbers), and read-only/permission issues not tested; only happy paths and clear errors exercised; (3) Design has minor fragility in Python YAML parsing helper and hardcoded expected values in integration harness. Fixture files referenced but contents not shown—tests assume they exist. Would catch most regressions in core flows but miss boundary conditions and input malformations.
